bio.text: Eddie Espinoza is the Green Party candidate in Texas's 34th Congressional District in 2026, according to the San Antonio Report.
The San Antonio Report describes Espinoza as a U.S. Army veteran who taught in Rio Grande Valley public schools for 26 years and who previously ran for a seat on the Texas Railroad Commission.
